pandas.io.formats.style.Styler.background_gradient

pandas 3.1.1 · Styling · method

Shade cell backgrounds according to numeric values and the selected color map.

Call syntax

Styler.background_gradient(…) Full signature
Styler.background_gradient(
    cmap='PuBu',
    low=0,
    high=0,
    axis=0,
    subset=None,
    text_color_threshold=0.408,
    vmin=None,
    vmax=None,
    gmap=None,
)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
import jinja2
frame = pd.DataFrame({"units": [2., 5., 7.], "price": [4., 3., 2.]})
